Inter-Agency Council for the Pasig River Urban Development.
The Inter-Agency Council for the Pasig River Urban Development ("Inter-Agency
Council") is hereby created, to be composed of the following:
Chairperson
Secretary, DHSUD
Vice-Chairperson : Chairperson, MMDA
Secretary, DPWH
Secretary, DENR
Secretary, DILG
Secretary, Department of Tourism
Secretary, Department of Transportation
Secretary, Department of Finance
Secretary, Department of Budget and Management
Chairperson, National Historical Commission of the
Philippines
Chairperson, National Commission for Culture and the Arts
General Manager, Philippine Ports Authority
Commandant, Philippine Coast Guard
General Manager, Laguna Lake Development Authority
Chief Executive Officer, Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise
Zone Authority
The National Housing Authority shall serve as the Secretariat of the
Inter-Agency Council, and shall provide administrative support to the
member-agencies thereof.
The Chairperson, Vice-Chairperson, and members of the Inter-Agency Council
may designate their alternates, with ranks not lower than an Assistant Secretary or its
equivalent, who are fully authorized to decide for or on their behalf.

Powers and Functions. The Inter-Agency Council shall have the
general function and responsibility of facilitating and ensuring the full rehabilitation of
the banks along the Pasig River water system and nearby water systems in order to
provide alternative transportation, propel economic opportunities, and boost tourism
activities. For this purpose, the Inter-Agency Council shall perform the following
a. Formulate a Pasig River Urban Development Plan which shall serve as the
blueprint for the rehabilitation of the banks along the Pasig River, its tributaries,
and surrounding communities, with the end in view of realizing its full potential for
mixed-use development, transportation, recreation, tourism, and sustainable
human settlement, taking into consideration its historic and cultural value;
2

b. Implement a coordinated and integrated rehabilitation of the Pasig Riverbanks
system and nearby water systems, and the construction of necessary
infrastructures in accordance with the Pasig River Urban Development Plan;
c. Ensure that easements provided under Republic Act No. 386 or the "Civil Code of
the Philippines" and other relevant laws or issuances are observed, including all
the esteros and waterways that drain into the Pasig River;
d. Study, prepare, and implement a comprehensive shelter plan for massive
relocation of informal settler families (ISFs) and other unauthorized or unlawful
occupants along the Pasig Riverbanks, which shall include: (i) identification of
suitable relocation sites; (¡i) strategies for economic and social integration of ISFs
in the area; and (i) long-term solutions to address ongoing migration into the Pasig
Riverbanks;
e. Accept grants, contributions, donations, endowments, bequests, or gifts in cash or
in kind from local and foreign sources in support of the formulation and
implementation of the Pasig River Urban Development Plan, subject to existing
laws, rules and regulations;
f. In coordination with concerned national government agencies and local
government units (LGUs), conduct a review of existing Presidential issuances
relative to the rehabilitation and development of the Pasig River, and recommend
to the Office of the President the repeal and/or amendment of the same; and
g. Perform such other functions as may be directed by the President.
As may be necessary, the Inter-Agency Council may call upon any government
department, agency, bureau, or instrumentality, including government-owned
or -controlled corporations, and invite LGUs and representatives from the private
sector, to provide assistance in attaining its objectives. Subject to compliance with
existing laws, rules and regulations, the Inter-Agency Council may facilitate
public-private partnerships to ensure the effective and efficient implementation of this
Order, as well as the Pasig River Urban Development Plan.

Funding. The initial funding requirements necessary for the
implementation of the Order shall be charged against the respective appropriations of
the member-agencies of the Inter-Agency Council. Thereafter, the funding
requirements necessary for the continued implementation of this Order shall be
included in the budget proposals of said agencies, subject to the usual budget
preparation process.

Implementing Guidelines. The Inter-Agency Council shall
formulate and issue quidelines as may be necessary for the effective implementation
of this Order.

Reporting. The Inter-Agency Council, through the DHSUD, is
hereby directed to submit to the Office of the President, through the Office of the
Executive Secretary, a quarterly status report on the implementation of this Order.
3

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is declared
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected shall
remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof
that are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 25th day of
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.
By the President:
LUCAS P. BERSAMIN
Exedutive Secretary
Office of the President
MALACAÑANG RECORDS OFFICE
ATTY. CORICEPCION LAY E. FERROLINO-ENAD
DIRECTOR IV
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
